title: Acceleration from graph
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the acceleration during the first 2 seconds using the slope of the v-t graph (Δv/Δt).

title: Force F via Newton's Law
description: Essential: Applies Newton's second law correctly to the first phase, solving for F using the net force equation (F - mg sinθ - μ mg cosθ = m a₁).

title: Time to highest point
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the time to reach the highest point after force removal using kinematics (0 = v₁ + a₂ t₂) with the correct a₂.

title: Final displacement calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total distance from the bottom after 1.8 seconds post-removal, combining upward and downward displacements.

title: Post-removal acceleration
description: Important: Correctly determines the acceleration (a₂) after force removal using Newton's second law, accounting for gravity and friction up the incline.

title: Velocity at t=2s
description: Important: Identifies the velocity at the moment the force is removed (v₁ = 8 m/s) from the graph or kinematics.

title: Downward acceleration
description: Optional: Correctly calculates the acceleration (a₃) when the object moves back down the incline after reaching the highest point.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect sign for the post-removal acceleration (a₂) or misapplies it in kinematic equations, leading to wrong time or displacement.

title: Friction direction mistake
description: Pitfall: Misidentifies the direction of the friction force during the upward motion after force removal, or omits it in the net force.

title: Unit or value omission
description: Pitfall: Final answers lack correct units or uses incorrect given values (sin37°, cos37°, μ, g).
